summary: American Water Works filed an 8-K reporting that on September 15, 2026, it, merger subsidiary Alpha Merger Sub and Essential Utilities filed a joint petition for non-unanimous settlement with the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission regarding their previously announced October 26, 2025 merger, under which Merger Sub would merge into Essential Utilities, which survives as a wholly owned American Water subsidiary. Settling parties include the Bureau of Investigation and Enforcement, Consumer Advocate, Small Business Advocate and others; some parties did not join. Administrative Law Judges will review and issue a Recommended Decision before PaPUC approval. Watch the non-joining parties' litigation risk and the regulatory clock.
